test_cases.title: Rows are ordered started_at DESC with id ASC tiebreak -- fails if ORDER BY is omitted or partial
test_cases.given: a signed-in developer persona with 4 user_sessions rows, two of which share the exact same started_at timestamp
test_cases.when: GET /api/personal-usage/{user_id}/sessions is called with page_size large enough to return all 4 rows in one page
test_cases.then: rows are ordered started_at DESC, and the two rows sharing started_at are ordered by id ASC as a deterministic tiebreak -- not database-default (arbitrary) order
test_cases.objective: Verify FR-2's exact ORDER BY clause (started_at DESC, id ASC). This TC is deliberately shaped so it would fail under an unordered or started_at-only ORDER BY: two rows share started_at, so a missing tiebreak makes their relative order nondeterministic across repeat calls.
